hypothesis: Irregular des.region should use cardinal connectivity and clip its fill to the supplied rectangle.
proof: C lspo_region uses the first corner as the flood seed and derives bounds from flood_fill_rm. That routine visits diagonal matches and does not receive the far corner. These behaviors differ intentionally from default selection.floodfill. The production JS region API matches executed C on the enumerated fixtures.
scope: Seven small layouts, each lit=0/1: diagonal pair, cardinal pair, separated gap, narrow/full far-corner variants, mixed ROOM/FOUNTAIN row, adjacent wall. Full 80x21 roomno/lit/edge maps plus flood bounds/counts compared. No universal flood-fill, mixed-terrain, arbitrary-Lua or level-generation equivalence claim.
supportedSetup: The isolated unit fixtures use the production lspo_region API; they are not individually claimed shipped-level witnesses. Eight separate unmodified shipped Wizard locate/Valkyrie goal loads use public wizard input.
expectedC: Diagonal pair fills two cells versus one for a separated gap. A four-cell connected row fills four with either single-point or enclosing far corner.
observedJS: 14/14 comparisons match all 1680 cell tuples and bounds/counts. Eight recording streams match; four Wizard locate recordings have source attribution, four Valkyrie goal ones retain unresolved attribution.
control: Diagonal versus gap distinguishes connectivity; far-corner variants produce identical full component bounds, disproving rectangular clipping for those fixtures.

cleanBaseVerification.result: Both commands exit zero; gameplay and scorer sources unchanged from analysis base.
